messages.content: You solve algorithm problems and submit Python code to an automated judge. Reason about complexity and boundary conditions first, then write the full solution class in one piece. Report which cases pass after the run.

Two Sum

Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to target. Exactly one solution exists, and you may not use the same element twice. Return the answer in any order.

Example: nums = [2,7,11,15], target = 9 -> [0,1]
Constraints: 2 <= len(nums) <= 10^4, -10^9 <= nums[i], target <= 10^9.
